validation.criteria: 200+ games in calibration and holdout; Brier below 0.25 and calibrated home-rate baseline; score MAE below fixed 28-point baseline; ECE <= 0.10.

reasons: Probability improvement not clear in week-block bootstrap
modelComparison.protocol: Tune 36 fixed candidates on the tuning year using earlier training only; refit through tuning year; calibrate probabilities on the next year; test the following year and audit completed current games. Never tune on either evaluation set. Week-block bootstrap uses 1,000 resamples. Candidate must improve score MAE by 0.15+, Brier by 0.002+, both 95% gain intervals above zero, margin MAE no worse, ECE <= min(0.075, baseline+0.01), 95% advanced coverage, and current-season non-regression.
modelComparison.limitations: Game-level statistics include garbage time to align drive counts with final scores. Points per drive includes all team points, including defense/special teams; pass mix is inferred from total PPA divided by per-play PPA when available. Opponent adjustment is online and approximate. Historical source revisions and date-level rather than publication-time availability can affect retrospective results.
